Struggling Family.name: Struggling Family
Struggling Family.description:
💸 Money was always short at home: second-hand uniforms, a parent on double shifts, bills on the kitchen table.

🧾 You learned to stretch every yen and to work for what you wanted.
⚠️ No allowance comes from home, and some months home needs yours.

📈 Grants: Endurance +1, Streetwise +5, Cooking +5
🎒 No extra starting Yen: only your course's starting money
💴 Student allowance: none
Struggling Family.traitNarrativeEffects: Struggling family; the player may set why (single parent, debt, illness, a closed business), else one parent working long shifts to keep a small rented apartment; original names, never canon. Money: no allowance; food, phone, clothes and weekends are paid from part-time work, prize money or help the story gives, and some months the family needs help with a bill. In play: a family that is proud and worried, a younger sibling who looks up to the character, calls that avoid the subject of money. Pressure: outings classmates can afford and they cannot, pride when help is offered, people offering easy money; the narrator raises them only when the story has earned it. Paths: a villain or vigilante path may start as money for home; a hero path means rent paid by a first agency salary one day. Childhood: second-hand clothes, cheap meals cooked at home, younger siblings to mind, a part-time job as soon as it was allowed.
